canonical.title: React tables at row scale: where the ceilings actually are

parent.title: Which React table component to use in 2026

siblings.title: The 2026 React table landscape: headless vs batteries-included vs commercial grid
siblings.summary: Only four candidates are genuinely alive in 2026 — TanStack Table, AG Grid, MUI X Data Grid and react-data-grid — and the real axis is not features but how many weeks of table you agree to write yourself.

siblings.title: Server-driven data: which React table actually does the work for you
siblings.summary: AG Grid's Server-Side Row Model and MUI X's Data Source are real server-driven engines; TanStack Table only gives you manual* opt-outs and hands you the state machine.

siblings.title: Enterprise React data-grid features and what they actually cost in 2026
siblings.summary: AG Grid Enterprise at $999/dev perpetual is the cheapest way to buy row grouping + pivot + Excel export; building the same on TanStack Table costs 25-50 dev-days, so buy wins below ~40 developers.

siblings.title: Styling and design-system fit: which React grid bends to your design system?
siblings.summary: If the design system is authoritative, go headless (TanStack Table, or shadcn's copy-paste wiring of it); grid-owned CSS is only worth it when you're buying AG Grid's feature set.

sources.title: react-data-grid-benchmark — results
sources.claim: Reproducible 50k-row / 20-column benchmark: JS gzip, ready median, scroll settle and mounted DOM cell counts.

sources.title: Vitashev/react-data-grid-benchmark
sources.claim: Publishes fixture, adapters, package lock and raw samples; README discloses the author ships Ace Grid.

sources.title: 1771 Technologies — performance benchmarks
sources.claim: Vendor benchmark (makers of LyteNyte Grid): 1M-row scroll LyteNyte 60 FPS, MUI 33, AG Grid 27.

sources.title: Benchmarked the top 6 React data grids
sources.claim: Cell-update FPS LyteNyte 51 / AG Grid 39 / MUI 22; Handsontable OOM-crashed above ~200k rows.

sources.title: Battle of the Rows — the limits of data performance
sources.claim: Competing vendor benchmark (RevoGrid): AG Grid at 1,297 MB for 100k rows, tab crash at 400k.

sources.title: MUI X Data Grid — Virtualization
sources.claim: Browsers cap scroll-container height: 17.5M px Firefox, 33.5M px Chrome/Edge/Safari. Community virtualization limited to 100 rows.

sources.title: TanStack Virtual issue #616 — max element height
sources.claim: Lists past ~1.68M items at 20px exceed the browser max element height; the tail becomes unreachable.

sources.title: Virtual scrolling beyond the browser's limit
sources.claim: Safari 33,554,428px / Chromium 16,777,216px; beyond that you must replace native scrolling.

sources.title: HighTable — virtual scroll beyond the cap
sources.claim: Caps the canvas at ~8M px and downscales scrollbar resolution above it; claims 1-px fidelity to ~2 trillion rows.

sources.title: AG Grid — Row Models
sources.claim: The client-side row model renders ~40 rows regardless of dataset size.

sources.title: AG Grid — Server-Side Row Model
sources.claim: SSRM moves the ceiling off the browser; the reference demo serves 10M records.

sources.title: AG Grid — High-frequency updates
sources.claim: applyTransactionAsync batches streaming updates outside React with a default 50ms flush window.

sources.title: MUI X issue #10952 — degradation at ~10 updates/sec
sources.claim: The grid degrades to unusable at ~10 row updates/second on a 400-row window.

sources.title: MUI X Data Grid — Performance
sources.claim: Performance depends on the caller keeping every non-primitive prop referentially stable.

sources.title: glideapps/glide-data-grid
sources.claim: Renders cells to HTML canvas instead of DOM nodes; accessibility acknowledged as unverified.

sources.title: Glide Data Grid
sources.claim: Vendor claims: millions of rows, native scrolling, hundreds of thousands of updates per second.

sources.title: npm registry — @glideapps/glide-data-grid
sources.claim: Latest published release is 6.0.3, dated 2024-02-03.

sources.title: Hacker News — canvas vs DOM grids
sources.claim: Canvas wins scroll and streaming, loses layout primitives and text behaviour.

sources.title: TanStack Virtual vs react-window vs react-virtuoso (2026)
sources.claim: Bundle ~5KB / ~6KB / ~17KB; all three hold 60 FPS at 100k items.

sources.title: TanStack Virtual — Introduction
sources.claim: Headless: computes indices and offsets, ships no markup; scroll-cap workarounds are the caller's problem.

sources.title: bvaughn/react-window
sources.claim: v2 is a full rewrite with dynamic row heights; latest release 2.2.7 (Feb 2026).

sources.title: TanStack Table — FAQ
sources.claim: Unstable columns/data (including an inline .filter()) cause an infinite re-render loop.

sources.title: Material React Table — Memoization guide
sources.claim: memoMode 'table-body' disables virtualization and most features.

sources.title: Material React Table — Column virtualization
sources.claim: Column virtualization only pays for itself at dozens of columns.

sources.title: Handsontable — Performance
sources.claim: The performance guide points at pagination and fixed dimensions — a bounded working set.

sources.title: npm registry — @tanstack/react-table
sources.claim: Latest release is 8.21.3 (Apr 2025); v9 is still not out as of July 2026.

sources.title: React Compiler
sources.claim: Auto-memoizes at build time, but cannot make a freshly-constructed array referentially stable.

sources.title: MUI X issue #20699 — 199 MB/refresh leak
sources.claim: DataGridPro leaks ~199 MB per data refresh at 100k rows, reaching 4.7 GB.
